_note: Provenance registry for every visual/third-party asset shipped with Pitchborn. Third-party entries are kept separate from original Pitchborn assets.

original.name: Club emblems
original.description: Procedurally generated SVG emblems from each club's real colours and initials (src/components/art/Crest.tsx). Not official crests.

original.name: Kits
original.description: Generated shirt illustrations from club colours (src/components/art/Kit.tsx). No licensed kit artwork.

original.name: Player portraits
original.description: Flat illustrated portraits generated from appearance values (src/components/art/Portrait.tsx).

original.name: Pitchborn logo and app icons
original.description: Original Pitchborn artwork (public/icon.svg and PNG renders).

thirdParty.name: Official club crests
thirdParty.author: Various (see per-file records)
thirdParty.license: Per file: public domain / CC0 / CC BY / CC BY-SA
thirdParty.usage: Identifying real clubs. Files in public/crests/, provenance in src/data/crests.json. Crests remain trademarks of their clubs; Pitchborn is not affiliated with or endorsed by any club.

thirdParty.name: flag-icons
thirdParty.author: Panayiotis Lipiridis & contributors
thirdParty.usage: Country flag SVGs, bundled via npm.

thirdParty.name: Lilita One
thirdParty.author: Juan Montoreano
thirdParty.usage: Display typeface (self-hosted by next/font at build time).

notBundled.name: Club crests without a free licence
notBundled.reason: Only crests whose Wikimedia Commons licence permits redistribution are bundled; other clubs use a generated Pitchborn emblem.

notBundled.name: League and competition logos
notBundled.reason: Trademarked. Original Pitchborn names are used for continental/international competitions and awards.

notBundled.name: Player photographs
notBundled.reason: All players are fictional; no photographs are used.

notBundled.name: Stadium photographs
notBundled.reason: Not needed for the current UI; Wikimedia Commons images could be added with per-file licence records.
